editorial:
Imagine you are on a sunny vacation, taking a boat trip to a quiet island, only to find out that almost everyone there has vanished. You and your friends end up stuck in a creepy spot where something is hunting you from the shadows. The vibe is very strange and eerie, especially when you start exploring that big, lonely house on the hill. Once you find that old diary in the hidden room, the mystery starts to unfold, and you realize you are in way over your head with some very hungry locals.

While the acting is a bit stiff and the plot moves slowly at times, the gore is what really makes this one stick. It is not for the faint of heart, but if you love old-school shockers, you will have a blast. It feels like a gritty fever dream. You should definitely try to find this on a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture quality, or just look for a rental on Apple TV if you want a quick scare tonight. It is a wild ride for any horror fan.
endingExplained: You eventually find out that the island is home to a group of cannibals who eat humans to survive. The big twist is that the terror is led by a madman who thinks this is normal. In the final scenes, the survivors fight for their lives in a bloody battle. Most of the bad guys get killed off in gross ways, and the few remaining heroes manage to escape the island just before everything falls apart.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s splatter films and creepy island mysteries.
